mainText: Good morning. Futures are rebounding after Tuesday's hot inflation selloff. The Dow is up a tenth of a percent, the S and P 500 up just under nine tenths, and the Nasdaq 100 up 1.9 percent. The 10-year Treasury yield is near 4.99 percent, up about 12 basis points from Monday's close, after briefly touching 5.01 percent on Tuesday. Note the bond market is closed today for Veterans Day, though stocks trade normal hours. Biggest movers: CoreWeave up 13 percent on strong earnings, with revenue of 3.66 billion dollars, up 168 percent from a year ago. Nvidia up 5.2 percent, rebounding after losing about 430 billion dollars in market value over the last two sessions. Rigetti is lower after a quarterly miss. Fossil is higher, with revenue more than doubling. Costco is down a tenth of a percent, after declaring a 30 dollar special dividend and a 4 billion dollar buyback.
